title: Bog Toads Near Westfen
summary: Bog toad sign has been found at the edge of Westfen: slime trails through flattened reeds. Helm Vesper wants 3 of them dealt with.
offer_text: "The bog toads have come closer to Westfen each night: croaking that stops when anyone comes near. Go to the edge and thin them out, before someone is hurt."
turn_in_text: "Quieter already. I will sleep tonight. A little."

stages.title: Go to the edge of town

objectives.text: Go to where the bog toads were seen
Tell Helm Vesper it is done

relationship.label: Kept the bog toads from the edge
